name: X-Ray Volume Rendering
aliases: Sparse matrix-vector product via ray tracing
definition: A volume rendering technique that accumulates voxel intensity values (color) linearly along a ray, similar to a CT scan, rather than using alpha compositing for transparency.
summary: X-Ray Volume Rendering is a direct volume ray casting technique that mimics CT scans by linearly summing voxel intensities along a ray, treating the volume as a projection where all samples contribute regardless of depth.
